description: Measure impact of data augmentation (translation, shuffling) on model performance across nominal and diverse test scenarios
hypothesis: Augmented training data improves model robustness on diverse inputs without significantly harming performance on nominal cases

train_formatted.description: Training data formatted without augmentation (English only)

train_augmented.description: Training data with 3x multiplication, translation (fr/es), shuffling

test_formatted.description: Held-out test set - nominal use cases (English only)

test_augmented.description: Held-out test set - diverse/edge cases (multilingual, varied formatting)

augmented.description: Model trained on augmented data (same compute budget)

tests.name: baseline_on_nominal
tests.description: Baseline model on nominal test cases

tests.name: augmented_on_nominal
tests.description: Augmented model on nominal test cases

statistical_analysis._note: Changed from 'bootstrap_paired' which does not exist (FM-1)

success_criteria.improved_generalization: E4 perplexity < E2 perplexity (augmented model generalizes better)
success_criteria.augmentation_benefit: (E4 - E2) < (E3 - E1) (augmentation helps more on diverse than it hurts on nominal)

interpretation.E1_vs_E3: Does augmented training hurt nominal performance?
interpretation.E2_vs_E4: Does augmented training improve generalization to diverse inputs?
interpretation.E1_vs_E2: How much does baseline struggle on diverse inputs?
interpretation.E3_vs_E4: How much does augmented model struggle on diverse inputs?
